name: Crest
tagline: A fix for Wavee closing by itself shortly after it starts on x64 PCs.

highlights.title: Wavee no longer closes by itself after starting
highlights.body: On x64 PCs, 0.3.8 and 0.3.9 could close a few seconds after launch, or when the window came back after a long time hidden. The cause was a defect in the preview .NET compiler they were built with; this release is built with the final .NET 11 and does not have it.
